title: On His Way to Die, Jesus Stopped
thread: A blind beggar, Bartimaeus, cried to Jesus, Son of David, for mercy by the road near Jericho; many told him to be quiet and he cried louder; Jesus, on the road to Jerusalem where He would be killed, stood still and called him; he threw off his cloak and came; Jesus asked what he wanted, he asked for his sight, and Jesus said his faith had made him whole; at once he could see and he followed Jesus on the road to Jerusalem, where Jesus died for our sins and rose the third day
